# Padmark

> Self-hosted Markdown notes, short links and account-based access. API release {{VERSION}}.

The API base is the origin serving this file (scheme, host and optional port). Resolve the
root-relative links below against that origin. If copying this index elsewhere, record that
base explicitly. The linked reference and OpenAPI are embedded in the same server build;
use the target instance's documents together when checking API compatibility.

Reading a note increments `views` and can start or complete burn-after-reading. Following
`/r/{id}` can consume a burn-after-click link. Use documentation or `/healthz` for discovery;
read content or follow redirects only when the user intends it.

An issued `pmk_…` value is an envelope: decode its base64url JSON, use `url` as the API base,
and send only its `token` field as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Do not send the envelope.

`privacy: public` allows anyone, `authenticated` allows any signed-in account, and `owner`
allows only the creating account. Mutations require the applicable privacy access and the
edit code or owning account; public creation does not require login. The server enforces
these rules. Save a returned edit code at creation: it is shown only once.

## API documentation

- [API reference](/api/reference.md): Notes, links, authentication, TTL and burn behavior, errors, and a safe discovery example.
- [OpenAPI contract](/api/openapi.yaml): Request and response schemas for this release; redirect and headless setup workflows are covered in the reference.

## Optional

- [Interactive API documentation](/api): Browser viewer for the same OpenAPI contract.
